requirements.quote:
Adj-RIB-In
      The Adj-RIBs-In contains unprocessed routing information that has
      been advertised to the local BGP speaker by its peers.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the unprocessed routing information advertised to the local BGP speaker by its peers in the Adj-RIBs-In.
requirements.why_checkable: The origin and processing status of information represented in the input RIB can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
Adj-RIB-Out
      The Adj-RIBs-Out contains the routes for advertisement to specific
      peers by means of the local speaker's UPDATE messages.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent routes for advertisement to specific peers through the local speaker's UPDATE messages in the Adj-RIBs-Out.
requirements.why_checkable: Outgoing RIB entries can be compared with the routes selected for each peer's UPDATE messages.

requirements.quote:
BGP Identifier
      A 4-octet unsigned integer that indicates the BGP Identifier of
      the sender of BGP messages.  A given BGP speaker sets the value of

requirements.why_checkable: The identifier data type and interpretation of its high bit can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
the sender of BGP messages.  A given BGP speaker sets the value of

requirements.condition: Setting a BGP speaker's BGP Identifier.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the BGP Identifier to an IP address assigned to that BGP speaker.
requirements.why_checkable: The configured identifier can be compared with addresses assigned to the speaker.

requirements.quote:
The value of the BGP Identifier is determined upon startup and is
      the same for every local interface and BGP peer.
requirements.required_behavior: Determine the value of the BGP Identifier upon startup.
requirements.why_checkable: Initialization code exposes when the identifier is determined.

requirements.quote:
The value of the BGP Identifier is determined upon startup and is
      the same for every local interface and BGP peer.
requirements.condition: A BGP speaker has multiple local interfaces.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the same BGP Identifier for every local interface.
requirements.why_checkable: Identifier values used across local interfaces can be compared.

requirements.quote:
The value of the BGP Identifier is determined upon startup and is
      the same for every local interface and BGP peer.
requirements.condition: A BGP speaker has multiple BGP peers.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the same BGP Identifier for every BGP peer.
requirements.why_checkable: Identifier values sent to distinct peers can be compared.

requirements.quote:
EBGP
      External BGP (BGP connection between external peers).
requirements.condition: Classifying a BGP connection between external peers.
requirements.why_checkable: The connection type selected for an external-peer session can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
External peer
      Peer that is in a different Autonomous System than the local
      system.
requirements.condition: Classifying a BGP peer as external.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the external-peer classification for a peer in a different Autonomous System from the local system.
requirements.why_checkable: Peer classification can be checked against local and remote AS membership.

requirements.quote:
IBGP
      Internal BGP (BGP connection between internal peers).
requirements.condition: Classifying a BGP connection between internal peers.
requirements.why_checkable: The connection type selected for an internal-peer session can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
Internal peer
      Peer that is in the same Autonomous System as the local system.
requirements.condition: Classifying a BGP peer as internal.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the internal-peer classification for a peer in the same Autonomous System as the local system.
requirements.why_checkable: Peer classification can be checked against local and remote AS membership.

requirements.quote:
Loc-RIB
      The Loc-RIB contains the routes that have been selected by the
      local BGP speaker's Decision Process.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the routes selected by the local BGP speaker's Decision Process in the Loc-RIB.
requirements.why_checkable: Loc-RIB contents can be compared with the Decision Process selections.

      Information (NLRI) field of an UPDATE message.  The path is the
